I can't give you an amount for caffeine, that one's for a doctor or dietitian, since what's reasonable depends on your body, your health and what else you take in. In general terms, many people drink coffee 30 to 60 minutes before training for the alertness boost. Tolerance varies a lot, and too much tends to show up as jitters, a racing heart, stomach trouble or wrecked sleep. If any of that sounds familiar, or you have a heart or blood pressure concern, check with your doctor.

A decent rule for training is to use whatever you can have without it costing you sleep that night, since sleep does more for your lifting than the coffee ever will.
